C_metric: C_A=Re(<ref_A|model_A>)/sqrt(q_A*w_A), after visible-only global phase alignment
band_definition: Each dyadic octave [2^b,2^(b+1)) in zero-based reference-probability rank is split at round(sqrt(2)*2^b).
global_phase_policy: normalize the model and align its global phase using only the visible overlap <reference_S|model_S> before all metrics; hidden and full coefficients are not used
